candidate.scope: standalone output-major raw-Q8 leaf only; never model-routed
candidate.design: A 256-thread, eight-wave WGP workgroup computed a 128-output x 128-token tile over K256. It staged source-compatible output-major block_q8_0 rows and K-major D4 Q8_1 activations in 57,856 bytes of dynamic LDS, used aligned 16-byte LDS fragment loads, issued two signed integer-WMMA K16 operations per 32-K scale interval, accumulated scaled products in FP32, and emitted BF16 output.
candidate.runtime_constraint: A raw sidecar was prospectively inadmissible because the traced dense-Q8 family is about 1.390 GiB; any advancing design would have had to replace T16 byte-neutrally and prove raw-compatible decode.

correctness.red: Collection failed because no callable/registered standalone raw-Q8 MMQ128 D4 module existed.
correctness.green_command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version-lcp3.txt PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest tests/test_gguf_q8_0_mmq_prefill.py -q

implementation_validation.initial_issue: The first body accidentally unrolled all four 32-K scale intervals, compiling at 256 VGPR with 418 VGPR spills and 1,388 private bytes per thread. It was not accepted as a valid measurement.
corrections: Kept the four 32-K scale intervals rolled, removing all spills.
Matched llama.cpp's WGP baseline compile mode instead of forcing -mcumode.
Replaced scalar LDS gathers with the source's aligned 16-byte fragment loads.
Instantiated an unchecked full-output body when out_features is divisible by 128 while retaining the checked tail body.
implementation_validation.final_static_core: 32 integer-WMMA instructions, 24 ds_load_b128 fragment loads, and 16 two-address LDS loads, matching the source fragment/WMMA counts.

microbench.protocol: W7900 HIP events, eight cycling weight copies per layout, three warmup cycles, 60 rotated measured repetitions per mode, cached builds. Modes were production Q8T16 two-wave FP16 WMMA, prequantized output-major raw MMQ128, and D4 quantization plus raw MMQ128.

development_trace.note: The final rejection uses only the corrected spill-free source-compatible body. Earlier values are retained here to show that the source-shape implementation gap was closed before applying the frozen gate.

decision.reason: After correcting spills, compile mode, fragment loads, and full-tile checks, the source-compatible raw body still missed the required production win by 3.95%; D4 packing increased the loss to 5.32%. The predeclared rule required both rows to beat production, and raw+T16 dual residency was independently forbidden.
decision.profiler: No rocprof/model route was run after the prospectively frozen primary gate failed. Static code-object inspection was used only to validate the standalone implementation before timing.
decision.source_disposition: Removed the standalone kernel, quantizer, wrappers, registry key, and tests; production source/defaults are unchanged.
decision.next: Close dense-Q8 prefill MMQ experiments over T16 or raw replacement layouts. Re-profile the clean pp512 residual and move to the next measured family rather than trying more Q8 tile variants.
